cgu.title: Terms of Service
cgu.article1P1: These Terms of Service (hereinafter "ToS") define the terms and conditions under which CarGuinée (hereinafter "the Publisher") makes available to users the CarGuinée website and mobile application (hereinafter "the Platform"), as well as the rights and obligations of the parties in this context.
cgu.article1P2: Any use of the Platform implies unconditional acceptance of these ToS.
cgu.article2P1: The use of certain Platform services requires the creation of a user account. The user agrees to provide accurate information and update it when necessary. The user is responsible for the confidentiality of their login credentials.
cgu.article2P2: An account can be created with the status of Client or Owner. The Owner status requires validation by the Platform administration.
cgu.article3Item1: Browse rental and sale vehicle listings
cgu.article3Item4: Communicate via the built-in messaging system
cgu.article4Item1: Use the Platform in accordance with its intended purpose and the laws in force in the Republic of Guinea
cgu.article4Item2: Not publish illegal, offensive or misleading content
cgu.article4Item3: Respect other users and communicate in good faith
cgu.article4Item4: Report any suspicious behavior or any breach of these ToS
cgu.article5P1: Rental and sale prices are freely set by owners. The Platform does not intervene in price negotiations between parties. The deposit amount is set by the owner and mentioned in the listing.
cgu.article5P2: The Platform reserves the right to collect commissions on transactions made through the Platform, in accordance with the pricing policy in effect.
cgu.article6P1: CarGuinée acts as an intermediary Platform. The Publisher cannot be held responsible for disputes arising between an owner and a customer, nor for damages resulting from the use of a vehicle rented or purchased through the Platform.
cgu.article6P2: Owners are solely responsible for the accuracy of information published on their listings (vehicle condition, documents, availability).
cgu.article7P1: The Publisher reserves the right to amend these ToS at any time. Users will be notified of any substantial changes. Continued use of the Platform after notification constitutes acceptance of the new ToS.
cgu.article8P1: These ToS are subject to the law of the Republic of Guinea. In case of dispute, the parties agree to seek an amicable solution before any legal action. Failing that, the competent courts of Conakry shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
